result.summary: The image depicts a high-speed multi-lane arterial road lacking any dedicated pedestrian infrastructure such as sidewalks or marked crossings. Pedestrians are forced to use the unpaved grassy shoulder, and the wide roadway geometry suggests high vehicle speeds with no physical protection for non-motorized users.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Separation
hazards.description: There is no sidewalk or paved shoulder, forcing pedestrians to walk in the grass immediately adjacent to high-speed traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right and left sides of the roadway

hazards.name: High-Speed Roadway Geometry
hazards.description: Multiple wide travel lanes without traffic calming or crossing infrastructure encourage high vehicle speeds.
hazards.location_in_image: Center of the image, the main roadway

interventions.title: Sidewalk Installation
interventions.description: Construct a paved sidewalk separated from the roadway by a buffer or curb to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Improvements
interventions.description: Install marked crosswalks, potentially with a pedestrian refuge island and warning signage, to facilitate safe crossing of the multi-lane road.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment is highly hostile, featuring a multi-lane arterial road with no sidewalks, marked crossings, or pedestrian-scale lighting. The presence of a bike lane provides some dedicated space, but the overall design prioritizes high-speed vehicle throughput over pedestrian safety and accessibility.

hazards.name: Absence of Sidewalks
hazards.description: Pedestrians are forced to walk in the bike lane or on the grass shoulder, directly adjacent to high-speed traffic.

hazards.name: Excessive Crossing Distance
hazards.description: The multi-lane configuration requires pedestrians to cross a wide expanse of pavement without any protected refuge or signalization.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Construct continuous paved sidewalks on both sides of the roadway to separate pedestrians from vehicular traffic.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Islands
interventions.description: Install raised refuge islands at potential crossing points to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Mark crossings with high-visibility continental patterns and add pedestrian warning signage to alert drivers.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a marked zebra crosswalk and a curb ramp at a residential intersection. A significant safety concern is the tall evergreen hedge at the corner, which severely obstructs sightlines between pedestrians and approaching motorists.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall evergreen hedges at the corner of the intersection block the view between pedestrians waiting to cross and drivers approaching from the side street.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove the tall vegetation at the corner to ensure clear sightlines for both pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Crossing Signage
interventions.description: Install 'Pedestrian Crossing' (W11-2) signs to alert drivers to the presence of the crosswalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment features a well-maintained sidewalk and a marked crosswalk on the residential side street. However, the main thoroughfare lacks designated crossing infrastructure and suffers from significant sightline obstructions due to tall hedges at the corner.

hazards.name: Sightline Obstruction
hazards.description: Tall hedges at the corner of the intersection block visibility between pedestrians on the sidewalk and drivers on the side street.
hazards.location_in_image: Left side of the image at the corner of the intersection

hazards.name: Lack of Main Road Crossing
hazards.description: There is no marked crosswalk or pedestrian warning signage for crossing the main thoroughfare.
hazards.location_in_image: Across the main roadway in the foreground/center

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Trim or remove the tall hedges near the corner to restore sightlines between pedestrians and motorists.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk across the main road with accompanying pedestrian warning signs.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install curb extensions to shorten the crossing distance and place pedestrians in a more visible position before they enter the roadway.
